title: IRC v2 for Goguma: TLS listener, SASL PLAIN, queries, chathistory, web push, read markers
description: client-survey.md §2. S1 TLS listener on a chosen address, off by default, same token, refuse without TLS; S2 lift §7.2 and §7.6 (queries -> one-to-one rooms; chathistory from store); S3 SASL PLAIN with the agent token, keep PASS; S4 push on by default with minimal payloads (soju.im/webpush encrypted to the phone), per-front-end switch, docs say what each relay sees. After the store groundwork. Decisions (Mark, 2026-11-21) in /data/tmp/survey-decisions.txt, to be recorded in docs/design/client-survey.md §10 and agent-frontends.md §7.
